title: 第718章 赌盘第717章 报名分组
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“这是二位姑娘的身份玉牌，还请当场滴血绑定。”
“参加擂台赛的时候，都需要提前检查你们的身份玉牌是否属于你们本人。”
“以防有人私下替赛的违规行为出现。”
“而且，身份玉牌可以提前存入一定数量的源晶。”
“这样一来，以后你们再来星斗天阙参加擂台赛。”
“报名费就可以自动从你们的身份玉牌中的源晶中扣除，十分的方便。”
“不仅如此。”
“擂台赛的奖励，以及赌盘上赢得的收益，都会一并发放至身份玉牌之中。”
“所以，身份玉牌对你们来说，十分的重要。”
“还请你们妥善保管好它们。”
侍女一脸认真的开口。
闻言，洛星凝与燕知微都一脸郑重地点了点头。
而后。
当着侍女的面，她们在各自的身份玉牌上，滴上一滴自己的鲜血。
如此一来。
除了她们自己。
其他任何人，即便拿到她们的身份玉牌，都无法使用。
“不知二位，想要什么时候进行擂台赛？”
“以及，具体的擂台赛类型？”
“在进行擂台赛之前，这些信息，都需要提前半个时辰告知。”

“然后，我们才能给你安排合适的对手，以及相应的擂台赛场次。”
“如果二位今天不打算进行擂台赛，现在就可以离开了。”
侍女继续开口。
洛星凝与燕知微相互对视了一眼，随即不约而同地露出笑意。
“我们想尽快进行擂台赛。”
“至于擂台赛类型，我们选择越级赛加车轮赛。”
洛星凝开口。
此话一出。
对面的侍女顿时愣在原地，眼睛瞪大，满脸都是震惊之色。
“那…那个，二位姑娘，你们确定？”
“要不，你们再考虑考虑一下？”
“你们刚来，可能还不了解擂台赛的残酷。”
“我建议你们，为了安全起见，还是选择常规的擂台赛比较合适。”
侍女也没有想到，洛星凝与燕知微竟然如此胆大。
一上来，就要越级赛，还要车轮赛。
这种情况，此前还从未出现过。
“多谢你的建议。”
“不过，我们对自己的实力很有自信。”
“你就按照我们的要求，去做吧。”
面对侍女的好心，洛星凝虽然很感激，但却依旧坚持自己的要求。

见洛星凝如此坚持，侍女最终只能无奈地叹了口气。
content_en:
"These are the jade identity cards of the two girls. Please drop your blood and bind them on the spot."
"When participating in the arena competition, you need to check in advance whether your identity jade badge belongs to you."
"In case someone violates the rules by substituting for the game privately."
"Moreover, the identity jade token can deposit a certain amount of source crystals in advance."
"In this way, you will come to Xingdou Tianque to participate in the arena competition in the future."
"The registration fee can be automatically deducted from the source crystal in your identity jade token, which is very convenient."
"It's more than that."
"The rewards from the arena competition and the profits won from the gambling board will be distributed to the identity jade tokens."
"So, the jade identity card is very important to you."
"Please also take good care of them."
The maid spoke seriously.
Hearing this, Luo Xingning and Yan Zhiwei both nodded solemnly.
then.
In front of the maids, they put a drop of their own blood on their respective jade tags.
This way.
Except themselves.
No one else can use their identity jade tokens even if they get them.
"I wonder when you two would like to have a group match?"
"And what is the specific type of arena competition?"
"Before the arena match, all this information needs to be informed half an hour in advance."
"Then, we can arrange a suitable opponent for you and the corresponding number of arena matches."
"If you two don't plan to compete in the arena today, you can leave now."
The maid continued to speak.
Luo Xingning and Yan Zhiwei looked at each other, and then smiled in unison.
"We want to have a ring match as soon as possible."
"As for the type of ring competition, we choose leapfrog competition plus wheel racing."
Luo Xingning spoke.
As soon as these words came out.
The maid opposite was suddenly stunned on the spot, her eyes widened, and her face was full of shock.
"Well... well, you two girls, are you sure?"
"How about you think about it again?"
"You have just arrived, so you may not understand the cruelty of the ring competition."
"I suggest you, for the sake of safety, it is more appropriate to choose a regular arena match."
The maid did not expect that Luo Xingning and Yan Zhiwei would be so bold.
As soon as you get up, there will be a leapfrog race and a wheel race.
This situation has never happened before.
"Thank you for your advice."
"However, we are very confident in our ability."
"Just do as we ask."
Although Luo Xingning was very grateful for the maid's kindness, she still insisted on her request.
Seeing Luo Xingning's persistence, the maid could only sigh helplessly.
